review.method: Independent compiled-state review from plan02 plus read-only plan03 codec review180 seconds; concrete reset/zero counterexamples corrected. Field mapping is checked against compiled declarations and both codec directions.
limitations: Private same-build field codec, no durable/public ABI
RTE restores normal instruction/run modes in actual 68000 template; retained modes at exception boundary are captured
Inactive later-model fields remain invariant zero; no later-model claim
